requirement_text: The system shall be reliable and the network connectivity in the supermarket shall be stable for smooth operations and data flow.
clarification_questions: What reliability and connectivity targets (uptime, packet loss) are required?
What does "smooth operations" mean in measurable terms?

requirement_text: User shall be required to register the software with a serial key provided in the kit.
user_story: As a customer, I want to register the software with the serial key from the kit, so that my copy is activated.
technical_task: Require registration of the software with the serial key included in the kit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid serial key from the kit, when the user registers the software, then registration succeeds.
Given an invalid serial key, when the user tries to register, then registration is refused.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The second criterion follows from "required".

requirement_text: User shall anticipate API responses in less than 2.5 seconds to maintain seamless application functionality.
user_story: As a user, I want API responses in less than 2.5 seconds, so that the application works without noticeable delay.
technical_task: Keep API response times under 2.5 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given an API request, when the response is measured, then it arrives in less than 2.5 seconds.
Given a response that takes 2.5 seconds or longer, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Typical load is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall receive information about the number of rows to be published before deciding whether to publish for informed decision-making.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to see the number of rows to be published before I decide to publish, so that I can make an informed decision.
technical_task: Display the number of rows that will be published before the publish action is confirmed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset ready to publish, when the user opens the publish step, then the number of rows to be published is shown.
Given the number of rows is shown, when the user has not confirmed, then nothing is published yet.

requirement_text: For the first permanent FCP failure, FDIR shall degrade the redundancy level of the FCP from 4 to 3.
requirement_text_raw: For the first permanent FCP failure, FDIR  shall (3.3.5.30) degrade the redundancy level of the FCP from 4 to 3.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want FDIR to lower the FCP redundancy level from 4 to 3 on the first permanent FCP failure, so that the system continues with fewer channels.
technical_task: On the first permanent FCP failure, have FDIR degrade the FCP redundancy level from 4 to 3.
acceptance_criteria: Given the first permanent FCP failure, when FDIR responds, then it degrades the redundancy level of the FCP from 4 to 3.
Given an FCP with no permanent failure, when FDIR checks it, then the redundancy level stays at 4.

requirement_text: OR if (DDPHibernMdOpnRequest equal 1 AND DDPPreventHibernate equal 0)) for longer than PPNM_DDPOpenDelay then the Timer DDPTimerOpen is started and the internal signal DDPTimerOpenState is set to 1.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the timer DDPTimerOpen started and DDPTimerOpenState set to 1 when DDPHibernMdOpnRequest equals 1 and DDPPreventHibernate equals 0 for longer than PPNM_DDPOpenDelay, so that the open is delayed correctly.
technical_task: Start Timer DDPTimerOpen and set the internal signal DDPTimerOpenState to 1 when DDPHibernMdOpnRequest equals 1 and DDPPreventHibernate equals 0 for longer than PPNM_DDPOpenDelay.
acceptance_criteria: Given DDPHibernMdOpnRequest equals 1 and DDPPreventHibernate equals 0 for longer than PPNM_DDPOpenDelay, when the condition is evaluated, then DDPTimerOpen is started.
Given the same condition, when it is evaluated, then DDPTimerOpenState is set to 1.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The leading "OR" refers to an earlier condition not shown.

requirement_text: System shall load data from the database.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to load data from the database, so that I see stored information.
technical_task: Load the required data from the database when the system needs it.
acceptance_criteria: Given data in the database, when the system needs it, then the data is loaded.
Given the loaded data, when the user views it, then it matches what is stored in the database.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which data is loaded is not stated.

requirement_text: After a successful precharging procedure the second contactor is closed and the precharging current is interrupted.
user_story: As a battery engineer, I want the second contactor closed and the precharging current interrupted after a successful precharging procedure, so that the circuit is fully connected.
technical_task: After a successful precharging procedure, close the second contactor and interrupt the precharging current.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful precharging procedure, when it completes, then the second contactor is closed.
Given a successful precharging procedure, when the second contactor is closed, then the precharging current is interrupted.

requirement_text: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.
user_story: As a new user, I want to create a Gmail account by giving my name, gender, password, mobile number and location, so that I can start using Gmail.
technical_task: Provide an account creation form that collects name, gender, password, mobile number and location.
acceptance_criteria: Given the form, when the user enters name, gender, password, mobile number and location and submits, then the account is created.
Given the form, when required details are missing, then the account is not created.
rationale: Role assumed: new user. "Like" suggests the list may not be complete.

requirement_text: The product shall be able to handle 10 000 concurrent users within 2 years of the initial launch.
requirement_text_raw: The product shall be able to handle 10 000 concurrent users within 2 years of the initial launch.'
user_story: As a business owner, I want the product to handle 10 000 concurrent users within 2 years of the initial launch, so that it supports expected growth.
technical_task: Plan capacity so the product can handle 10 000 concurrent users within 2 years of the initial launch.
acceptance_criteria: Given 2 years after the initial launch, when 10 000 users are connected at once, then the product handles them.
Given 10 000 concurrent users, when they use the product, then it continues to respond.

requirement_text: The system shall allow for user ID and password input.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter my user ID and password, so that I can sign in.
technical_task: Provide input fields for user ID and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login screen, when the user opens it, then fields for user ID and password are shown.
Given the fields, when the user enters a user ID and password, then they are accepted as input.

requirement_text: User shall enter their full name and date for last time authorization.
user_story: As a user, I want to enter my full name and the date for the last time authorization, so that the authorization is recorded.
technical_task: Ask for the user's full name and a date when performing the last time authorization.
acceptance_criteria: Given the authorization step, when the user enters a full name and a date, then they are accepted.
Given the authorization step, when the full name or date is missing, then authorization is not completed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. What "last time authorization" refers to is not explained.

requirement_text: Only adjusters can request recycled parts audit reports. No users without an adjuster role shall request recycled parts audits.
requirement_text_raw: Only adjusters can request recycled parts audit reports. No users without an adjuster role shall request recycled parts audits.'
user_story: As a claims manager, I want only adjusters to request recycled parts audit reports, so that these audits are controlled.
technical_task: Allow only users with the adjuster role to request recycled parts audits and audit reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with the adjuster role, when the user requests a recycled parts audit report, then the request is accepted.
Given a user without the adjuster role, when the user requests a recycled parts audit, then the request is refused.

requirement_text: User shall accommodate a minimum of 10,000 records of clients in the database.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want the database to hold at least 10,000 client records, so that it supports our client base.
technical_task: Size the database to store a minimum of 10,000 client records.
acceptance_criteria: Given 10,000 client records, when they are stored, then the database accepts them all.
Given 10,000 client records stored, when a record is requested, then it is returned.

requirement_text: Then this person's electronic records are accessible via the iTrust Medical Records system.
requirement_text_raw: Then  this person's electronic records are accessible via the iTrust Medical Records system.
rationale: The sentence is a fragment that depends on a previous step not given.
clarification_questions: Who is "this person" and what comes before "Then"?
What must the system do to make the records accessible?

requirement_text: The system shall provide clear and informative messages to users.
rationale: "Clear and informative" are subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What makes a message "clear and informative"?

requirement_text: Applicants shall be advised to change their passwords monthly.
user_story: As an applicant, I want to be advised to change my password monthly, so that my account stays secure.
technical_task: Prompt applicants every month to change their password.
acceptance_criteria: Given an applicant whose password is a month old, when the applicant signs in, then the applicant is advised to change it.
Given an applicant who changed the password within the month, when the applicant signs in, then no advice is shown.
rationale: Role stated: applicant. Advising is not forcing a change.

requirement_text: System maintains an audit trail of errors and exceptions.
user_story: As a system operator, I want an audit trail of errors and exceptions, so that I can review failures.
technical_task: Record every error and exception in an audit trail.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs, when it is handled, then it is recorded in the audit trail.
Given an exception occurs, when it is handled, then it is recorded in the audit trail.

requirement_text: The application shall be HTML and scripting language-based, allowing end users to use the system on any web browser and any hardware platform available now or in the future.
user_story: As an end user, I want the application to be HTML and scripting language based, so that I can use it on any web browser and any hardware platform, now or later.
technical_task: Build the application on HTML and a scripting language so it runs in any web browser on any hardware platform.
acceptance_criteria: Given a web browser, when the user opens the application, then it works.
Given a hardware platform that supports a web browser, when the user opens the application, then it works.
rationale: Role assumed: end user. "Any ... in the future" cannot be tested directly.

requirement_text: The counter shall increase monotonically after that, except during TNR.
requirement_text_raw: The counter shall (3.2.2.7.8) increase monotonically after that, except during TNR.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the counter to increase monotonically afterwards except during TNR, so that time never runs backwards.
technical_task: Make the counter increase monotonically after that point, except while TNR is in progress.
acceptance_criteria: Given the counter is running outside TNR, when it is read repeatedly, then each value is not smaller than the previous one.
Given TNR is in progress, when the counter is read, then it may change differently from monotonic increase.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "After that" refers to an earlier event not shown.

requirement_text: System shall display the full news report after a user chooses the corresponding news title.
user_story: As a reader, I want to see the full news report after choosing its title, so that I can read the story.
technical_task: Display the full news report when its title is selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of news titles, when the user selects a title, then the full news report is displayed.
Given two titles, when the user selects each, then each shows its own report.

requirement_text: 100% of saved user preferences shall be restored when system comes back online.
requirement_text_raw: 100\% of saved user preferences shall be restored when system comes back online.'
user_story: As a user, I want 100% of my saved preferences restored when the system comes back online, so that I don't lose my settings.
technical_task: Restore all saved user preferences when the system restarts.
acceptance_criteria: Given saved user preferences, when the system comes back online, then 100% of them are restored.
Given a restored preference, when the user views it, then it has the saved value.

requirement_text: The application shall render images and effects efficiently to maintain a productive workflow.
clarification_questions: Which images and effects, and what workflow time targets apply?

requirement_text: All information transmitted for the purposes of supporting claims or pay for performance payments will be logged in an audit file that cannot subsequently be changed by a user or administrator of the EHR solution.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want all information sent to support claims or pay for performance payments logged in an audit file that no user or administrator can change, so that the log can be trusted.
technical_task: Log all information transmitted for claims or pay for performance payments in an audit file that users and administrators of the EHR solution cannot modify.
acceptance_criteria: Given information is transmitted to support a claim or a pay for performance payment, when it is sent, then it is logged in the audit file.
Given the audit file, when a user or administrator of the EHR solution tries to change it, then the change is not allowed.

requirement_text: System shall be easy to upgrade.
clarification_questions: What makes the system "easy to upgrade" in measurable terms (time, steps, downtime)?

requirement_text: The operational NEs shall enter a "working group" TNR routine when the FCPs request to send a TNR packet.
requirement_text_raw: The operational NEs shall (3.2.2.4.3) enter a "working group" TNR routine when the FCPs request to send a TNR packet.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the operational NEs to enter a "working group" TNR routine when the FCPs request to send a TNR packet, so that TNR packets are handled.
technical_task: Make the operational NEs enter the "working group" TNR routine whenever the FCPs request to send a TNR packet.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCPs request to send a TNR packet, when the request is made, then the operational NEs enter a "working group" TNR routine.
Given no FCP requests to send a TNR packet, when the NEs run, then they do not enter the "working group" TNR routine.

requirement_text: The server shall have a supported version of a common Linux distribution (Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.10, CentOS, Debian, or RHEL).
user_story: As an administrator, I want the server to run a supported version of a common Linux distribution, so that it receives updates.
technical_task: Run the server on a supported version of Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.10, CentOS, Debian or RHEL.
acceptance_criteria: Given the server, when its operating system is checked, then it is one of Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.10, CentOS, Debian or RHEL.
Given the chosen distribution, when its version is checked, then it is a supported version.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The list is taken from the requirement.

requirement_text: The Khan Academy platform shall offer instructional resources in mathematics.
user_story: As a student, I want instructional resources in mathematics on the Khan Academy platform, so that I can learn the subject.
technical_task: Offer instructional resources in mathematics on the Khan Academy platform.
acceptance_criteria: Given the platform, when a user browses subjects, then mathematics is offered.
Given the mathematics section, when a user opens it, then instructional resources are shown.

requirement_text: The BE shall be able to initiate a processing task on any Backend processor.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the BE to start a processing task on any Backend processor, so that work can be placed anywhere.
technical_task: Let the BE initiate a processing task on every Backend processor.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Backend processor, when the BE initiates a processing task on it, then the task starts there.
Given several Backend processors, when the BE initiates a task on each, then each task starts on its processor.

requirement_text: The system shall allow the user to modify the date exclusion set of an already submitted meeting response.
user_story: As a meeting participant, I want to change the date exclusion set of a meeting response I already submitted, so that I can correct my availability.
technical_task: Allow editing of the date exclusion set of a meeting response that has already been submitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a submitted meeting response, when the user changes its date exclusion set, then the change is saved.
Given a changed date exclusion set, when the response is viewed, then it shows the new exclusions.

requirement_text: The website should use Flash to provide animation on the home page.
requirement_text_raw: The website should use Flash to provide animation on the home page.'
user_story: As a visitor, I want animation on the home page using Flash, so that the page feels lively.
technical_task: Implement the home page animation with Flash.
acceptance_criteria: Given the home page, when it is displayed in a browser that supports Flash, then an animation is shown.
Given the home page implementation, when it is reviewed, then the animation is provided with Flash.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. "Should" makes this a recommendation.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to update match statistics, including match date and result, and display the updated statistics.
user_story: As a league organizer, I want to update match statistics including match date and result and see the updated statistics, so that records are current.
technical_task: Support updating match statistics, including match date and result, and display the result of the update.
acceptance_criteria: Given a match, when the organizer updates its date and result, then the match statistics are saved.
Given updated match statistics, when they are viewed, then the updated statistics are displayed.

requirement_text: In case of unmanaged services, user shall be able to access a QoS configuration function implemented in the CNG.
user_story: As a network user, I want to access a QoS configuration function in the CNG for unmanaged services, so that I can set quality of service.
technical_task: Implement a QoS configuration function in the CNG that users can access when services are unmanaged.
acceptance_criteria: Given unmanaged services, when the user opens the CNG configuration, then a QoS configuration function is accessible.
Given the QoS configuration function, when the user changes a setting, then the setting is applied in the CNG.
rationale: Role assumed: network user. The settings are not listed.

requirement_text: System shall offer comprehensive documentation for installation, configuration, and usage, as well as troubleshooting guides and FAQs for resolving common issues.
user_story: As an administrator, I want documentation for installation, configuration and usage with troubleshooting guides and FAQs, so that I can solve common issues.
technical_task: Write documentation covering installation, configuration and usage, plus troubleshooting guides and FAQs for common issues.
acceptance_criteria: Given the documentation, when it is reviewed, then it covers installation, configuration and usage.
Given the documentation, when it is reviewed, then it includes troubleshooting guides and FAQs for common issues.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Comprehensive" is not measured.

requirement_text: After a message is sent the LHCP is directed to to his or her message outbox.
requirement_text_raw: After a message is sent  the LHCP is directed to to his or her message outbox.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to be directed to my message outbox after sending a message, so that I can see it was sent.
technical_task: Redirect the user to the message outbox once a message is sent.
acceptance_criteria: Given an LHCP sends a message, when sending completes, then the LHCP is directed to the message outbox.
Given the message outbox, when it is displayed, then the sent message is listed.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: System shall provide read-only access to archival descriptions.
user_story: As a researcher, I want read-only access to archival descriptions, so that I can look but not change them.
technical_task: Provide read-only access to archival descriptions.
acceptance_criteria: Given an archival description, when a user views it, then it is displayed.
Given an archival description, when a user tries to change it through this access, then the change is not allowed.

requirement_text: System shall provide comprehensive session information associated with sponsors.
clarification_questions: How are sessions associated with sponsors?

requirement_text: System shall ensure 24/7 availability of the interface and maximal security of the network.
rationale: "Maximal security" is not measurable and the interface is not named.
clarification_questions: What does "maximal security" of the network mean in testable terms?

requirement_text: System shall display a stylistic map view in the application.
user_story: As a user, I want a stylistic map view in the application, so that the map matches the look of the app.
technical_task: Add a stylized map view to the application.
acceptance_criteria: Given the application, when the user opens the map, then a stylistic map view is displayed.
Given the map view, when it is shown, then it is part of the application.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Stylistic" is not defined.

requirement_text: System shall provide functionality for users to assign Location information to Containers.
user_story: As a records officer, I want to assign Location information to Containers, so that I know where each is kept.
technical_task: Add a Location field to Containers that users can fill in.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Container, when the user assigns Location information, then it is saved with the Container.
Given a Container with Location information, when it is viewed, then the Location is shown.

requirement_text: Only administrators can activate a pre-paid card.
requirement_text_raw: Only administrators can activate a pre-paid card.'
user_story: As an administrator, I want only administrators to activate a pre-paid card, so that cards are controlled.
technical_task: Limit pre-paid card activation to administrators.
acceptance_criteria: Given an administrator, when the administrator activates a pre-paid card, then the card is activated.
Given a user who is not an administrator, when the user tries to activate a pre-paid card, then it is refused.

requirement_text: The system shall implement measures to prevent unauthorized physical or digital access.
user_story: As a security officer, I want measures that prevent unauthorized physical or digital access, so that the system is protected.
technical_task: Implement controls that block unauthorized physical access and unauthorized digital access.
acceptance_criteria: Given a person without authorization, when the person attempts digital access, then access is denied.
Given a person without authorization, when the person attempts physical access, then access is prevented.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The measures are not specified.

requirement_text: The system shall allow camp administrators to add parents for camper enrollment.
user_story: As a camp administrator, I want to add parents for camper enrollment, so that campers can be enrolled.
technical_task: Allow camp administrators to add parents to the camper enrollment process.
acceptance_criteria: Given a camper being enrolled, when the camp administrator adds a parent, then the parent is linked to the enrollment.
Given an enrollment with a parent, when it is viewed, then the parent is shown.

requirement_text: System provides an audit trail and viewable history of all transactions including but not limited to user’s login ID date and time stamp.
requirement_text_raw: System provides an audit trail and viewable history of all transactions including but not limited to  user’s login ID  date  and time stamp.
user_story: As an auditor, I want an audit trail and viewable history of all transactions, including login ID and date and time stamp, so that I can review activity.
technical_task: Keep an audit trail and a viewable history of every transaction, including at least the user's login ID and a date and time stamp.
acceptance_criteria: Given a transaction, when it is completed, then the audit trail records the user's login ID and a date and time stamp.
Given the audit trail, when an auditor opens the history, then all transactions are viewable.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. "Not limited to" means other fields may be recorded.

requirement_text: Click 'Add' to schedule an office visit.
user_story: As a receptionist, I want to click Add to schedule an office visit, so that I can book visits.
technical_task: Provide an Add button that starts scheduling of an office visit.
acceptance_criteria: Given the schedule, when the user clicks Add, then the office visit scheduling is started.
Given the scheduling, when the user completes it, then the office visit is scheduled.

requirement_text: User shall be able to connect via IP address.
user_story: As a user, I want to connect via an IP address, so that I can reach the system directly.
technical_task: Allow connections to be made using an IP address.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid IP address, when the user connects with it, then the connection is established.
Given an invalid IP address, when the user tries to connect, then the connection is not established.

requirement_text: The system shall be highly available and accessible for data access and management.
clarification_questions: What availability percentage counts as "highly available"?
Which data access and management functions does this cover?

requirement_text: The Scheduler shall detect 50 Hz, 10 Hz, and 1 Hz frame overruns at the next frame following the end of their respective rate boundaries.
requirement_text_raw: The Scheduler shall (3.3.4.12) detect 50 Hz, 10 Hz, and 1 Hz frame overruns at the next frame following the end of their respective rate boundaries.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the Scheduler to detect 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz frame overruns at the next frame after the end of their rate boundaries, so that overruns are caught promptly.
technical_task: Have the Scheduler detect overruns of the 50 Hz, 10 Hz and 1 Hz frames at the next frame following the end of each rate boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 50 Hz frame overruns its rate boundary, when the next frame starts, then the Scheduler detects the overrun.
Given a 10 Hz or 1 Hz frame overruns its rate boundary, when the next frame starts, then the Scheduler detects the overrun.

requirement_text: The system shall manage the entire software lifecycle, including version control, download, activation, and retrieval.
user_story: As a release manager, I want the system to manage the whole software lifecycle, including version control, download, activation and retrieval, so that software is handled in one place.
technical_task: Manage the software lifecycle, including version control, download, activation and retrieval.
acceptance_criteria: Given a software version, when it is managed, then version control is available.
Given a software version, when a user downloads, activates or retrieves it, then each action is supported.

requirement_text: The BE shall trap, flag and repair infs, NaNs, underflows, overflows and other computation errors.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the BE to trap, flag and repair infs, NaNs, underflows, overflows and other computation errors, so that bad values do not spread.
technical_task: Detect, flag and correct infs, NaNs, underflows, overflows and other computation errors in the BE.
acceptance_criteria: Given a computation produces an inf, NaN, underflow or overflow, when the BE detects it, then it is trapped and flagged.
Given a trapped computation error, when the BE handles it, then it is repaired.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. How repair is done is not described.
